name: Camp Wydaca
description_short: Wyckoff Family YMCA outdoor day camp for ages 3 through grade 8, with traditional and weekly specialty camps by grade. Every camper gets two swim periods a day at the Y's Spring Lake Beach Club, plus art, sports on the turf and themed activities; specialty camps add sports, performing arts or STEAM periods.

fees.name: After Camp Clubs
fees.note: Grades 1 to 5, 4 to 5 pm; offsite tennis club $200 a week

refund_policy_summary: Deposits are not refundable and the Y gives no refunds. Changes are free through June 1, 2027, then cost $50 per camper per change; withdrawing after June 1 forfeits 50% of the week's tuition (the rest becomes account credit), and within 5 business days of the week forfeits all of it.
notes: Price is the kindergarten camp's program member and non-member rate ($460 a week); full Y members pay $420. Prices for other grades are on each program's page. Little Explorers half day (ages 3 to 4, 9 to noon) is $320 a week non-member, $280 member. A $125 deposit per week ($75 for Little Explorers) goes toward tuition. Camp day 9 am to 3:15 pm; before camp care 7:30 to 9 am and after camp care 4 to 6 pm cost extra (prices not posted yet). Registration opens to the public December 2, 2026. Grades are as of September 2027; age_max derived from grade 8.
